tips: By default, hold B or either Ctrl key to open the radial menu on the campaign map. Move the cursor toward an ability, then release the key to use it.
Change hotkeys, mouse bindings and wheel settings in LunaLib under Campaign Radial Menu.
To edit a radial menu slot, hold the left mouse button over it for half a second. Choose an ability, clear the slot, or add a submenu to the main wheel.
Hover over a submenu in the radial menu to open its outer ring. Move the cursor outward to select an ability, or back to the center to close the submenu.
To cancel a radial menu selection, move the cursor to the center before releasing the hotkey, or press Escape.
Hover over an ability in the radial menu to see its tooltip. Press F1 for additional details where available.
